name: org.litote/errance
title: Errance
description: Hosted MCP App, public transport worldwide powered by Transitous: journeys, boards, real time, maps

tools.name: search_places
tools.description:
Searches stops, addresses and points of interest by name (geocoding), or lists what is near coordinates
(reverse geocoding when 'text' is 'lat,lon'). Returns what to give to the other tools: the id of a stop, the
'lat,lon' of another place (address, point of interest, city).
Not needed before the other tools, which take place names: use it when the user asks for places.

text.description: Name to search (e.g. 'Lyon Part-Dieu'), or 'lat,lon' for reverse geocoding.

near.description: 'lat,lon' to favor results near this position.

language.description: Preferred language of the names, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de). The names of the stations are translated in fr, es, en, nl, de and it ("Gérone" for Girona in fr).

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Describes the MOTIS server: version, real-time and shared mobility (GBFS) availability, limits, default map position.

tools.name: explore_area
tools.description:
Shows on a map the public transport stops and routes (lines) of an area, given by a place and a radius
or by bounds. Use it to discover which transit data is available somewhere; not for a journey (plan_journey).
The returned routeIdx values can be passed to route_details, the stopId values to departures.

place.description: Center of the area: place name, stop name or 'lat,lon'.

modes.description: Only the stops and routes of these modes.

language.description: Preferred language of the names, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de). The names of the stations are translated in fr, es, en, nl, de and it ("Gérone" for Girona in fr).

tools.name: route_details
tools.description: Shows a route (line) on a map with all its stops and its shape. 'routeIdx' comes from explore_area.

language.description: Preferred language of the names, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de). The names of the stations are translated in fr, es, en, nl, de and it ("Gérone" for Girona in fr).

tools.name: reachability
tools.description:
Computes every stop reachable from (or, with arriveBy, to) a place by public transport within a maximum
travel time (isochrone), and shows them on a map colored by travel time.

place.description: Origin: place name, stop name, stop id or 'lat,lon'.

time.description: Departure (or arrival) date-time, ISO-8601: with offset, or in the local time of the place. Default: now.

arriveBy.description: true: places from which 'place' can be reached.

language.description: Preferred language of the origin name, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de).

tools.name: departures
tools.description:
Next departures (or arrivals) at a stop, with real-time delays, cancellations and tracks when available.
Give 'stopId' (from search_places or explore_area) or a stop name in 'stop'.
For a railway station, the first page also lists the lines of the station (all its stops within 200 m): their
departures are given by 'station' true, with 'modes' and 'lines'.
Service alerts (disruptions, works, closed lines or elevators) active at the time of a leg or departure are numbered after it, e.g. 'alerts [1]', and listed at the end: tell the user briefly about those of the options you propose. The itineraries do not avoid the lines with an alert: warn when one says the service is interrupted (NO_SERVICE).

stop.description: Stop name, resolved by geocoding (used when stopId is missing).

time.description: Start date-time, ISO-8601: with offset, or in the local time of the stop. Default: now.

station.description: true: departures of all the stops of the station (within 200 m), not only of this stop.

lines.description: Only these lines of the station (names listed in the station lines), with 'station' true.

pageCursor.description: Cursor returned by a previous call, to get the next or previous page.

language.description: Preferred language of the names, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de). The names of the stations are translated in fr, es, en, nl, de and it ("Gérone" for Girona in fr).

tools.name: trip_details
tools.description: All the stops of a trip (one vehicle run) with their times. 'tripId' comes from departures or plan_journey. Service alerts (disruptions, works, closed lines or elevators) active at the time of a leg or departure are numbered after it, e.g. 'alerts [1]', and listed at the end: tell the user briefly about those of the options you propose. The itineraries do not avoid the lines with an alert: warn when one says the service is interrupted (NO_SERVICE).

realTimeTripId.description: The realTimeTripId of the departure, if it has one: the same train in another feed, which gives its real time.

language.description: Preferred language of the names, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de). The names of the stations are translated in fr, es, en, nl, de and it ("Gérone" for Girona in fr).

tools.name: plan_journey
tools.description:
Computes public transport itineraries between two places (names, stop ids or 'lat,lon'),
with walking legs, transfers and real-time data. Shows them as a list and on a map.
Give it the place names of the user as they are: no need to search them first.
Fails listing the candidates when a name is ambiguous: call it again with the value given for the right one.
Between city names (e.g. 'Paris' to 'Nantes'), the long-distance itineraries start and end at the stations,
without the local legs to/from the city center; give an address for door-to-door itineraries.
The itineraries do not all leave from (or arrive at) the same station: give the user the station of each one
(departure, arrival: name, time, local time and track of the boarding in the first vehicle and of the leaving of the last one).
Service alerts (disruptions, works, closed lines or elevators) active at the time of a leg or departure are numbered after it, e.g. 'alerts [1]', and listed at the end: tell the user briefly about those of the options you propose. The itineraries do not avoid the lines with an alert: warn when one says the service is interrupted (NO_SERVICE).

from.description: Origin: place name, stop id or 'lat,lon'. Default: 'position'.

to.description: Destination: place name, stop id or 'lat,lon'. Names are searched near the origin.

position.description: Current position of the user, 'lat,lon': origin when 'from' is missing, else favors the places near it.

time.description: Departure (or arrival with arriveBy) date-time, ISO-8601: with offset, or in the local time of the origin. Default: now.

arriveBy.description: true: 'time' is the latest arrival time.

maxWalkMinutes.description: Maximum walk (or bike ride) to the first stop and from the last stop, in minutes (default 25): lower for a user who walks little.

wheelchair.description: true: accessible paths for a wheelchair user.

transferMargin.description: COMFORTABLE: 5 more minutes reserved for each transfer (default NORMAL).

bike.description: Bike of the user: TO_STATION (ridden to the first stop, then left there), ON_BOARD (carried on board, ridden at both ends; only trips allowing bikes). Default NONE.

pageCursor.description: Cursor returned by a previous call, for earlier or later itineraries.

language.description: Preferred language of the names, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de). The names of the stations are translated in fr, es, en, nl, de and it ("Gérone" for Girona in fr).

tools.name: rentals
tools.description:
Shared mobility (GBFS) in an area: bike, scooter and car sharing providers, their stations with available
vehicles and docks, and free-floating vehicles. Shown on a map.

place.description: Center of the area: place name, stop name or 'lat,lon'.

language.description: Preferred language of the place name, as ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, de).
